text:
**DECISION:** Set a 48×48 px minimum touch target for all interactive elements on EXCAVA’s mobile view.

This ensures fat-finger safety and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance without crowding the interface. The trade-off is slightly larger tap zones, which may reduce pixel-dense layouts—but clarity beats cramped controls every time.
